IEcommerceMallCustomer.ISummary is a lightweight customer summary for list displays. The schema includes x-autobe-database-schema annotation pointing to 'ecommerce_mall_customers'. Properties id, email, created_at map directly to the customers table, display_name requires JOIN to customer_profiles, and status is computed from deleted_at. This is a read DTO used for API responses, database-backed, and directly maps to customer records. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallGuestSession is a read DTO for guest session data retrieved via GET /guest/sessions/{sessionId}. The schema contains x-autobe-database-schema: ecommerce_mall_guest_sessions indicating direct database mapping. Queries ecommerce_mall_guest_sessions table by id with JOIN to ecommerce_mall_guests for guest details. This is a read response DTO (IActorSession) that transforms database records to API response format. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallSuperAdmin is a read DTO with x-autobe-database-schema property indicating direct mapping to ecommerce_mall_super_admins table. All properties map directly to table columns (id, email, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at). Transformable.

IEcommerceMallCustomerSession.ISummary has x-autobe-database-schema: ecommerce_mall_customer_sessions. All properties map directly to table columns (id, ip, href, referrer, created_at, updated_at, expired_at). This is a Read DTO for session listing responses, database-backed, and has direct one-to-one mapping to the ecommerce_mall_customer_sessions table. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallAdminRequest.ISummary is a read DTO for list displays of admin requests. The schema definition shows x-autobe-database-schema: ecommerce_mall_admin_requests with direct field mappings (id, actor_type, requested_grade, status, created_at) and reviewer association via JOIN on reviewed_by_id. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallSuperAdmin.ISummary is a read DTO for list displays. All properties (id, email, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at) map directly to columns in ecommerce_mall_super_admins table. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallAdminAuditLog.ISummary is a Read DTO for listing admin audit log entries. Maps to ecommerce_mall_admin_audit_logs table via x-autobe-database-schema annotation. Direct mapping with JOIN to ecommerce_mall_admins for admin summary. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallCustomerSession is a read DTO used for API responses that maps directly to the ecommerce_mall_customer_sessions database table. The DTO has x-autobe-database-schema: 'ecommerce_mall_customer_sessions' and all properties are direct mappings from the table columns (id, access_token, refresh_token, ip, href, referrer, created_at, updated_at, expired_at) with a JOIN to ecommerce_mall_customers for the customer property. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallSellerAdminRequest.ISummary is a summary DTO for listing seller admin privilege requests. The schema explicitly maps to ecommerce_mall_seller_admin_requests via x-autobe-database-schema property. This is a Read DTO used for paginated list displays, database-backed with direct mapping to the seller_admin_requests table. All transformable criteria are met: Read DTO, DB-backed entity, and direct table mapping.

IEcommerceMallCancellationRequestSnapshot.ISummary maps directly to ecommerce_mall_cancellation_request_snapshots table. It is a read DTO (ISummary suffix) for immutable cancellation request snapshots captured when sellers approve or reject. Contains id, reason, status, created_at fields with direct table mapping. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallSellerAdminRequest is a complete entity DTO used for API responses. It has x-autobe-database-schema 'ecommerce_mall_seller_admin_requests' indicating direct mapping to the ecommerce_mall_seller_admin_requests table. Contains seller and reviewedBySuperAdmin relations which are transformable nested DTOs. This is a database-backed read DTO with direct one-to-one mapping to a single table, making it transformable.

IEcommerceMallAdminRequest is a complete admin request entity used for API responses. It maps directly to ecommerce_mall_admin_requests database table with direct column mappings (id, actor_type, requested_grade, reason, status, reviewed_reason, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at). Has belongs-to relation to reviewer via JOIN with ecommerce_mall_super_admins. This is a Read DTO that is DB-backed with direct table mapping.

IEcommerceMallSuperAdminAuditLog.ISummary is a summary DTO for super admin audit log entries used in list displays. The schema shows x-autobe-database-schema: ecommerce_mall_super_admin_audit_logs, indicating direct mapping to the audit_logs table. It is a read DTO (ISummary pattern), database-backed from ecommerce_mall_super_admin_audit_logs, and has direct field mapping to database columns (id, action, target_type, target_id, ip, user_agent, created_at). Transformable.

IEcommerceMallCancellationRequestSnapshot is an immutable historical record of cancellation request state captured when seller responds. It maps directly to ecommerce_mall_cancellation_request_snapshots table with direct column mappings (id, reason, status, created_at) and a join to cancellation_request.ISummary. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallRefundRequestSnapshot.ISummary is a Read DTO for API responses. Maps directly to ecommerce_mall_refund_request_snapshots table with direct field mappings (id, snapshot_reason, snapshot_status, seller_response, seller_response_reason, created_at) and belongs-to relations (customer, refundRequest, seller). Transformable.

IEcommerceMallShippingAddress.ISummary is a read DTO for shipping address list displays. The schema explicitly defines x-autobe-database-schema: 'ecommerce_mall_shipping_addresses' with all properties mapping directly to table columns. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallAdminAuditLog is an immutable audit trail record for administrative actions. Maps directly to ecommerce_mall_admin_audit_logs table with a JOIN to ecommerce_mall_admins for the admin relation. This is a Read DTO, database-backed, and has direct table mapping. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallProductImage.ISummary is a lightweight product image DTO for list displays. The interface schema shows x-autobe-database-schema: ecommerce_mall_product_images, confirming direct mapping to the product_images table. Properties (id, image_url, display_order, created_at) map directly to table columns. This is a read DTO used in API responses, database-backed, and has direct mapping. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallSellerProfileSnapshot.ISummary is a Read DTO with x-autobe-database-schema pointing to ecommerce_mall_seller_profile_snapshots. The DTO properties (id, shop_name, shop_description, logo_url, created_at) directly map to database columns. This is a transformable entity snapshot DTO.

IEcommerceMallProductImage.IProtocol is a read DTO for product image records in list responses. Maps directly to ecommerce_mall_product_images table with direct field mappings (id, image_url, display_order, created_at, updated_at). Transformable.
IEcommerceMallProductVariant maps to ecommerce_mall_product_variants table. Transformable - direct DB-backed entity with HAS-MANY relation to optionValues table.

IEcommerceMallInventoryRecord is a Read DTO for inventory records. Maps directly to ecommerce_mall_inventory_records table with x-autobe-database-schema annotation. Contains direct fields (id, quantity_change, reason, created_at) and a JOIN to productVariant relation. Also includes a computed calculated_stock_quantity property. This is a database-backed entity used for API responses, making it transformable.

IEcommerceMallProductSnapshot.ISummary is a read DTO used for product snapshot listings. It maps directly to ecommerce_mall_product_snapshots table with a JOIN on ecommerce_mall_sellers. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallOrder.ISummary is a Read DTO used for paginated order listings. Based on x-autobe-database-schema annotation, it maps to ecommerce_mall_orders table with JOIN to ecommerce_mall_customers for customer summary. Properties directly map to database columns (id, order_number, status, total_amount, created_at). Transformable.

IEcommerceMallOrder is a complete order entity with x-autobe-database-schema: ecommerce_mall_orders. It maps directly to the ecommerce_mall_orders table with direct fields (id, order_number, subtotal, shipping_cost, total_amount, status, timestamps) and JOIN relations to customer and shippingAddress. This is a Read DTO used for API responses, database-backed from ecommerce_mall_orders table, and has direct mapping. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallCategory.IInvert is a read DTO for retrieving a specific category by ID with hierarchical context. The schema has x-autobe-database-schema: ecommerce_mall_categories, indicating it maps directly to the categories table. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallSuperAdminAuditLog.IInvert is a read DTO with x-autobe-database-schema marking it to ecommerce_mall_super_admin_audit_logs. It maps directly to database table with JOINs to super_admins (superAdmin) and metadata entries (metadataEntries). Transformable.

IEcommerceMallSellerProfileSnapshot maps to ecommerce_mall_seller_profile_snapshots table. It is a Read DTO for API responses containing immutable snapshot data with shop_name, shop_description, logo_url, and created_at fields plus a joined sellerProfile. Direct database mapping with x-autobe-database-schema property present. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallOrder.IInvert is a complete order details response with nested customer context, shipping address, order items with product/seller snapshots, and shipments. The x-autobe-database-schema annotation indicates it maps to ecommerce_mall_orders table. It is a read DTO used for API responses, database-backed, and has direct mapping to the orders table. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallOrderItem.ISummary maps to ecommerce_mall_order_items table with direct column mappings (id, quantity, unit_price, status, created_at), computed field (subtotal), and belongs-to relations (order, productSnapshot, sellerProfileSnapshot). Transformable DTO.

IEcommerceMallShipmentItem is a read DTO for API responses representing individual shipment items. It directly maps to the ecommerce_mall_shipment_items table with direct column mappings for id and created_at, and includes a belongs-to relation to orderItem with nested product snapshot, seller profile snapshot, and product variant details.

IEcommerceMallShipment.ISummary is a read DTO for listing shipments. The x-autobe-database-schema indicates ecommerce_mall_shipments as the primary table. Direct mappings: id, carrier, tracking_number, created_at. Contains computed item_count via aggregation and nested order via JOIN. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallCancellationRequest.ISummary is a read DTO for list views of cancellation requests. Maps to ecommerce_mall_cancellation_requests table with JOINs to customer, seller, and order item summaries. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallCancellationRequest is a complete cancellation request entity DTO used for GET/POST operation responses. Maps directly to ecommerce_mall_cancellation_requests table via x-autobe-database-schema annotation. Contains nested relations (orderItem, customer, seller) and HAS-MANY snapshots. This is a Read DTO, DB-backed, with direct mapping to one primary table. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallRefundRequest.ISummary is a Read DTO for listing refund requests. The schema has x-autobe-database-schema: ecommerce_mall_refund_requests indicating direct mapping to the refund_requests table. It contains essential fields (id, status, reason, created_at) and BELONGS-TO relations (customer, seller, orderItem) for navigation. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallReviewSnapshot is a Read DTO representing immutable review snapshots for dispute resolution. The interface schema shows direct 1:1 mappings to ecommerce_mall_review_snapshots table (id, rating, body, created_at, review_id). All properties have x-autobe-database-schema annotations. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallRefundRequestSnapshot.IInvert is a Read DTO using IInvert pattern that maps directly to ecommerce_mall_refund_request_snapshots table. The schema shows x-autobe-database-schema: ecommerce_mall_refund_request_snapshots with direct column mappings and belongs-to relations (refundRequest, customer, seller). Transformable - databaseSchemaName set to ecommerce_mall_refund_request_snapshots.

IEcommerceMallShipment is a complete shipment entity used for API retrieval responses. The x-autobe-database-schema annotation confirms it maps to ecommerce_mall_shipments table. It has direct field mappings (id, carrier, tracking_number, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at) and nested relations (order, seller, shipment_items). This is a Read DTO backed by database, making it transformable.

IEcommerceMallSellerApproval.ISummary is a read DTO for listing seller approval records. The schema has x-autobe-database-schema: ecommerce_mall_seller_approvals, confirming direct mapping to the seller approvals table. Contains status, timestamps, and BELONGS-TO relations to seller and reviewing admin. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallSellerSuspension.ISummary is a read DTO for listing seller suspension records. The interface schema shows x-autobe-database-schema: ecommerce_mall_seller_suspensions indicating direct database mapping. Contains fields from ecommerce_mall_seller_suspensions table with JOIN relations to seller and admin summaries. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallAdmin.ISummary is a lightweight summary DTO for admin list views. All properties (id, email, name, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at) map directly to ecommerce_mall_admins columns. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallOrderItem is a Read DTO for order item retrieval with x-autobe-database-schema: 'ecommerce_mall_order_items'. Maps directly to ecommerce_mall_order_items table with direct field mappings (id, quantity, unit_price, status, created_at, updated_at). Nested objects (productSnapshot, sellerProfileSnapshot, productVariant) are relation joins. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallSellerApproval is a complete entity DTO with x-autobe-database-schema 'ecommerce_mall_seller_approvals'. Maps directly to ecommerce_mall_seller_approvals table with id, status, rejection_reason, created_at, updated_at fields. Includes belongs-to relations to sellers and admins. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallSellerSuspension is a read DTO for seller suspension audit records. The interface schema explicitly maps to ecommerce_mall_seller_suspensions table with direct column mappings (id, reason, restored_reason, suspended_at, restored_at, created_at, updated_at) and belongs-to relations to sellers and admins. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallInventoryRecord.ISummary maps to ecommerce_mall_inventory_records table with BELONGS-TO relation to product variants. Direct property mappings (id, quantity_change, reason, created_at) from database columns. Read DTO for paginated list responses. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallShipmentTracking is a read DTO representing shipment tracking data returned in API responses. The interface schema x-autobe-database-schema indicates it maps to ecommerce_mall_shipments table with direct field mappings: carrier -> carrier, tracking_number -> trackingNumber, created_at -> shippedAt. This is a direct one-to-one mapping from database table to DTO structure, making it transformable.
IEcommerceMallAdminPromotion maps to ecommerce_mall_admin_promotions table with belongs-to relations to admins and super_admins. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallAdminPromotion.ISummary is a read/summary DTO for admin promotion audit records. It has x-autobe-database-schema: 'ecommerce_mall_admin_promotions' indicating direct mapping to the database table. Contains admin_id FK resolved to admin ISummary and performed_by_super_admin_id FK resolved to performedBySuperAdmin ISummary. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallProductSnapshotVariantOptionValue is a read DTO used for API responses with direct field mappings from ecommerce_mall_product_snapshot_variant_option_values table (id, key, value, created_at). Per x-autobe-database-schema annotation, it maps directly to the database table. The FK to variant snapshot is excluded as composition children are accessed through parent. All transformable criteria met: Read DTO + DB-backed + Direct mapping.

IEcommerceMallGuest.ISummary maps directly to ecommerce_mall_guests table. All properties (id, fingerprint, ip_address, user_agent, last_active_at, created_at) are direct column mappings from the guest table. This is a read DTO used for API responses, database-backed, and has direct 1:1 mapping. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallSellerProfile.ISummary is a transformable DTO. It is a Read DTO used for list displays and reference contexts, backed by the ecommerce_mall_seller_profiles table with a JOIN to ecommerce_mall_sellers via seller_id. The schema confirms direct mapping from id, name, description, logo_uri fields. A transformer will be generated to convert database rows to this DTO.

IEcommerceMallProductSnapshotImage maps directly to ecommerce_mall_product_snapshot_images table. It is a Read DTO for API responses, database-backed with direct mapping to one primary table. Contains id, url, displayOrder, createdAt, updatedAt, and parent productSnapshot reference. Transformable.

IEcommerceMallSuperAdminAuditLogMetadatum maps directly to ecommerce_mall_super_admin_audit_log_metadata table. The DTO has x-autobe-database-schema annotation confirming this mapping. All properties (id, key, value, created_at) are direct column mappings from the database table. This is a Read DTO for audit log metadata entries. Transformable.
